name: skillfile
description: One-stop shop for AI skills and agents. Search 110K+ community skills, install and track them declaratively, and deploy across all major AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity and more)

categoryDescription: 开发、调试、评审、测试、架构与工程交付
howToUse: 阅读仓库 README 的安装要求，将 Skill、插件或工具接入对应环境，再按文档触发工作流。
